title: Beautiful microwave table
text: Beautiful microwave table. Love this item, it arrived super fast in about three days! I was looking for a table that was wide and long enough for my microwave. I am so happy with this purchase and it looks beautiful in my kitchen!!

product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Kitchen Island with 3 Shelves, 47.2 Inches Kitchen Shelf with Large Worktop, Stable Steel Structure, Industrial, Easy to Assemble, Rustic Brown and Black UKKI01BX
features: [Large Worktop] The 23.6”D x 47.2”W surface of this kitchen island allows you to prepare food while being spacious to keep a toaster or coffee machine close by. Large worktop for great convenience!

[3-Tier Storage] Place a flower vase or a tea set on the top, kitchen appliances on the middle shelf, and storage boxes with bakeware on the lower grid shelf—everything is nicely organized on this 3-tier Island table with easy access

[Versatile] With a 35.4" height, this kitchen table is exceptionally versatile: use it as a breakfast table to grab a bite to eat, a coffee bar for coffee machine and accessories, or a bar table for serving up drinks...totally up to you!
[No Wobbles, No Scratches] Say bye to small annoyances—the adjustable feet prevent the kitchen island from wobbling on slightly uneven floors and protect your floor from unwanted scratches
[Assembly Is a Snap] No tricky assembly here. With clear instructions, numbered parts, and an assembly tool included, you’ll be able to assemble this baker’s rack before you know it

details.Special Feature: Space Saving, Easy to assemble, Adjustable Feet, Scratch Resistant
details.Product Care Instructions: Wipe with Dry Cloth, Wipe with Damp Cloth
